temporal_guards.note: Adopted, draft, emerging, examination and scheduled states must remain distinct.
Future consultation dates must not be recorded as completed.
Inspector report receipt is not adoption.
Green Belt removal recommendation is not adopted boundary change.
Brownfield register review date is not parcel suitability proof.
Plan timetable data may be MHCLG-created and requires authority cross-check.
Plan event vocabulary does not prove a borough event occurred.
Local plan dataset may contain current, emerging and historical rows.
Local plan housing dataset has zero active rows and cannot support scoring.
Draft London Plan cannot override the adopted London Plan.
Lambeth 2029 adoption is a target, not a completed event.
Enfield examination status must be checked against the latest council page.
Havering evidence review is not an adopted update.
Source crawl date is not the policy effective date.
Dataset collector date is not geometry currency proof.
Weekly application publication is not application-to-parcel matching.
Call for sites submission is not allocation.
Brownfield Part 1 inclusion is not full planning permission.
Permission in Principle is distinct from full planning permission.
Plan timetable changes require current publication evidence.
Local plan event dates require plan-specific linkage.
Legacy-system and 2026-system plan records must remain separate.
Historical records must not be used as current policy.
Unknown temporal state must fail closed.

conflict_gates.note: Positive growth layer plus Green Belt requires explicit conflict resolution.
Site allocation plus flood zone requires constraint review.
Brownfield status plus conservation area requires heritage review.
Opportunity Area boundary is indicative and needs borough confirmation.
Industrial land potential and protected industrial designation must be reconciled.
Metropolitan Open Land blocks automatic positive scoring.
Safeguarding layers block automatic positive scoring.
Tree preservation coverage blocks automatic positive scoring.
Listed building points do not prove listed-building extent.
Article 4 direction requires exact polygon applicability.
Planning Data and borough ArcGIS disagreement must fail closed.
Count, objectIds and feature probes must agree.
API error cannot be interpreted as zero results.
HTTP success without valid JSON cannot be accepted.
Zero result applies only to the queried layer or dataset.
Metadata response cannot establish spatial intersection.
Area-level housing requirement cannot establish parcel growth.
Draft policy evidence cannot create a parcel score.
Register boundary caution requires primary-source cross-check.
Positive intersection requires retained raw response and hashes.
Duplicate entity records must be reconciled.
Multiple intersecting constraints require conservative conflict handling.
Score remains null until all required positive and negative gates pass.
Any unresolved contradiction preserves NO_DATA.

system_validations.note: All network URLs use approved HTTPS hosts.
Exactly five verified new official sources.
Unbound score remains null and confidence zero.
Global current task is not replaced.
No new or duplicate runner is created.
